about: #951: each case is a source, a faithful rewrite every surface must accept and a wrong rewrite every surface must reject. Surfaces: reader (article summary), sitrep (Briefing line over highlights, each source sentence a highlight), overview (one fact citing the whole source as its passage), worldTension (summary over headlines, each source sentence a headline). knownGaps names the surfaces whose current checks accept the wrong rewrite; the test asserts them as they are, so a fix flips them on purpose.

cases.source: The ministry said the dam was not damaged in the strike on Tuesday.
cases.faithful: The ministry said the dam was not damaged in Tuesday's strike.
cases.wrong: The ministry said the dam was damaged in the strike on Tuesday.

cases.source: Police said the man allegedly set fire to the warehouse.
cases.faithful: Police said the man allegedly set fire to a warehouse.
cases.wrong: Police said the man set fire to the warehouse.

cases.source: At least 12 people were killed in the flooding, the regional governor said.
cases.faithful: The regional governor said at least 12 people were killed in the flooding.
cases.wrong: The regional governor said at least 21 people were killed in the flooding.

cases.source: Health Minister Anna Berg said the hospital would close in March. The union said the closure was illegal.
cases.faithful: Health Minister Anna Berg said the hospital would close in March.
cases.wrong: The union said the hospital would close in March.

cases.source: Police said 3,000 people joined the march. Organisers said 20,000 people took part.
cases.faithful: Police said 3,000 people joined the march, while organisers said 20,000 took part.

cases.source: The central bank could raise interest rates in June if inflation stays above 4%.
cases.faithful: The central bank could raise interest rates in June if inflation stays above 4 percent.
cases.wrong: The central bank raised interest rates in June as inflation stayed above 4%.

cases.source: Senator Maria Lopez introduced the bill on Monday, her office said.
cases.faithful: Senator Maria Lopez introduced the bill on Monday.
cases.wrong: Senator Maria Ortiz introduced the bill on Monday.

cases.source: Prosecutors summoned the former minister for questioning on Tuesday.
cases.faithful: Prosecutors summoned the former minister on Tuesday.
cases.wrong: Prosecutors arrested the former minister on Tuesday.

faithfulOnly.source: The minister said he would resign at the end of the month.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: The minister said he will resign at the end of the month.

faithfulOnly.source: The new law would take effect in March, the ministry said.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: The new law takes effect in March, the ministry said.

faithfulOnly.source: Insurance claims rose 12 percent last year, the regulator said.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: Payouts requested from insurers rose 12 percent last year, the regulator said.

faithfulOnly.source: The council said housing plans were approved on Tuesday.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: The council said a housing scheme was approved on Tuesday.

faithfulOnly.source: The accused appeared in court on Monday.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: The defendant appeared in court on Monday.

faithfulOnly.source: The economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: The economy grew faster than forecast in the third quarter.

faithfulOnly.source: The bridge reopened on Friday, and engineers said repairs to the road could take weeks.
May saw record sales for the carmaker.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: The carmaker had record sales in May.

faithfulOnly.source: The U.S. imposed tariffs on steel imports.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: The US imposed tariffs on steel imports.

faithfulOnly.source: The United Kingdom will host the summit next year.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: The UK will host the summit next year.

faithfulOnly.source: John Smith, the finance minister, presented the budget.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: Finance minister Mr Smith presented the budget.

faithfulOnly.source: Three people were injured in the crash.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: 3 people were injured in the crash.

faithfulOnly.source: 2 people were injured in the crash.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: Two people were injured in the crash.

faithfulOnly.source: Police said 12 people were killed in the flooding. The mayor said 3 schools were closed in the town.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: 12 people were killed in the flooding.

faithfulOnly.source: Police said 3,000 people joined the march. Organisers said 20,000 people took part.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: Police said 3,000 people marched, while organisers put the figure at 20,000.

faithfulOnly.source: Police said 12 people died in the flooding.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: Police reported that 12 people died in the flooding.

faithfulOnly.source: Police said the man allegedly set fire to the warehouse.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: Police said the man reportedly set fire to the warehouse.

faithfulOnly.source: Officials in Ukraine said new energy measures took effect on Monday.
faithfulOnly.rewrite: Energy officials in Ukrainian regions said measures took effect on Monday.

wrongOnly.source: Police said the man allegedly set fire to the warehouse.
wrongOnly.rewrite: Police said the man could have set fire to the warehouse.

wrongOnly.source: Officials announced new measures on Monday.
wrongOnly.rewrite: Minister Ann announced new measures on Monday.
